chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 13 (Legislative branch) houses Subchapter III Lobbying Regulation (Wis. Stat. §§ 13.61 et seq.), Wisconsin's lobbyist registration and expenditure-disclosure statute body.

notes: 2015 vintage uses slug convention chapter-13/ rather than the /13/ directory seen in WI 2010. Ch. 19 (General duties of public officials) was considered as a possible parallel ethics regime but contains the general code-of-ethics for public officials/employees rather than a separate lobbying-disclosure body — declined per Rule 4.
